title: יקנעם — הבית שבקצה, גרסה ב'
brief: כחול: מחלקה שהגיעה בחסות הבתים ממזרח מטהרת את הבית שבקצה המערבי של יקנעם עילית, בלי סיוע אש. אדום: מחזיק בבית, פניו אל השטח הפתוח במערב. לפני הקרב כל צד מתכנן את משימתו.

window.place: The southern edge of Yokneam Illit on Ramat Menashe (יקנעם עילית, רמת מנשה): the town's houses on the hill in the south-east, Route 6 (כביש 6) in the west, low ground to the north.

about: The house at the edge (yokneamHouse) with the defender's reserve (decision 105): the scenario for
the counterattack inside (decision 104, the author, 2026-10-21). Everything as in
yokneamHouse, and a second RED squad of the same platoon held back as its reserve
(decision 60): 88 m south of the defended house's door, in full cover, out of sight
of the platoon's start. It holds fire until committed (the author: "farther back,
holding fire"); when the house is being cleared round its squad it runs for the
door and goes in, clearing the attacker's rooms back.
Placed first 30 m away (behind the next house, then behind the defended one): the
battle was decided in turn 1, by the reserve's and the house's assaults on the
platoon in the open at the door (docs/balance.md).
⚠️ Ours: the exact spot and the reserve's strength, and everything yokneamHouse
